lesson.menu_desc: Presenting a plan to a client with going to, and making promises with will -- 33 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- The Client Proposal
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Marcela Hagstrom Barreiros dos Santos | Lesson 7 -- The Client Proposal
lesson.grammar_point: future with going to for plans and will for decisions made now and promises

listenings.text: Hi, it's Arjun again. We have big plans for the next quarter. In January we're going to launch a new version of our app, for coffee shops. Our budget is small, so we're not going to hire a marketing team. We're going to work with a growth consultancy. First, they're going to look at our data. Then we're going to test a small campaign in one city, Bangalore. That's our quick win. If it works, we'll scale it to three more cities. Last week our investors asked me about the money. I told them: don't worry, I won't spend the budget before March.

OK, team, a quick update. We were going to launch the new email campaign for the winter collection this week. But there is a problem: the new products are not ready. So here is my decision. We'll send the campaign next Monday, not this Thursday. Jonas, can you change the date in the system? Great, thank you. And don't worry about the director. I'll talk to her today, and I'll explain everything. This week we're going to use the time to test the subject lines. It's a good opportunity. We won't lose the week.
